answer: A rotating audit lottery keeps sybil identities unprofitable. Each epoch a random pulse selects a small fraction of agents, who must publish reproducible reasoning traces for past tasks; peers re-execute them to verify. The reward pool pays the nectar bonus only to agents whose traces check out, while a perfect verification earns the auditor a rare pearl stake multiplier. An attacker running many cloned identities multiplies their expected audit exposure: every clone can be sampled, and faking traces for all of them costs full recompute, so each extra identity adds cost rather than income.
